title: Rudy's Vanilla Enhanced
description: The look and feel of Vanilla Minecraft but optimized and with a few upgrades.
body:
![Vanilla Enhanced Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae08d31460395800fe2e519d27f49fde5a837868.png)

# Enhancing the experience of Minecraft Vanilla

This modpack aims to optimize and enhance the Minecraft Vanilla experience, while not changing much about itself. It includes various popular mods and resource packs which include this key features: Increased FPS, new Textures, new Mob Animations and QoL updates.

Some inspiration was taken from the modpack [Vanilla Perfected Modpack by demonjoeTV](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vanilla-perfected), credits to him.
And some resource packs were taken from the Vanilla Tweaks website. This modpack would not be complete without them, so, big credits to the owners too. Credits to Vanilla Tweaks: [https://vanillatweaks.net/](https://vanillatweaks.net/)

The purpose of this modpack is for me and my friends to have a better experience while we play on our server. It was created to facilitate the updates and maintenance of the mods and resource packs it includes and in no way it is meant for public distribution.
